about: The falsifier, measured on a copy of the tree at 327: a place's keys read inputs no page of it reads. The reach key carried the second head's epoch, so every word it said again, agreeing as before, unsettled every place; the fold key carried the gate ledger's digest, so every line a gate landed missed every kept fold; and the fold key never read capsule.bound, so a kept fold rendered an index for a declaration it never read.
